headline: What Surat has promised about its water, and by when
intro: Three dated commitments, all from one document and all owned by the corporation itself. Surat's register is short because its promises are concentrated: the reuse programme is the thing SMC has publicly bound itself to, and it has bound itself twice, at 2030 and 2035.

status_legend.stated: Publicly stated by the institution, with a date. Not independently verified as on track.

update_model: History is kept, never overwritten. A status changes only against a dated citation.

commitments.title: Reuse 70% of treated wastewater by 2030
commitments.what: SMC states a vision to raise reuse of treated wastewater from the present level, which it puts at more than 30%, to 70% by 2030. At the 1,018 MLD it currently collects and treats, 70% is roughly 713 MLD against the 330 MLD reused today.
commitments.source_label: Surat Municipal Corporation, 'Reuse of Treated Used Water: A Successful Model', 8 March 2024, slide 'Way Forward'

commitments.title: Reuse 100% of treated wastewater by 2035, zero liquid discharge
commitments.what: The same document commits to 100% reuse and zero liquid discharge by 2035. SMC names the projects it expects to get there: 340 MLD to Hazira-based industries from the Bhesan-Asarma-Variav-Kosad plants, and 140 MLD to industries at Kadodara and Palsana from the Varachha-Valak-Kamrej plant.
commitments.source_label: Surat Municipal Corporation, 'Reuse of Treated Used Water: A Successful Model', 8 March 2024, slide 'Way Forward'

commitments.title: Comprehensive sewerage coverage of 100% of area and population by 2033
commitments.what: The drainage department states a commitment to 100% coverage in terms of geographical area and population by 2033. Its stated position at the time was 202 sq km covered, which it put at 99% of the then-habitable area, and 99.5% of population - but explicitly 'before city limit extension in June 2020', which took the corporation to 462.149 sq km. The denominator moved after the percentage was calculated.
commitments.source_label: Surat Municipal Corporation, 'Reuse of Treated Used Water: A Successful Model', 8 March 2024, slides 'Sewerage System' and 'Sewerage Scenario'
